text:
Maya: quick idea 1 1 want to run a small pricing page experiment next week focused on mid-market self-serve. scope: FAQ tightening, alternate tier names, and two microcopy variants in the calculator. goal = nudge ~5% of demo-intent to start trial.

Alejandro: good. primary metric? trial CTR on pricing?

Maya: yes 1 trial CTA clicks primary, contact-sales secondary, demo quality tertiary.

Samir: calc: keep math identical. change only copy, default seats, CTA. two variants: Neutral vs Conversational. flags ready.

Kate: add two CTA nudge lines to test: "Estimate monthly cost in 30s" vs "See discount options for committed seats". will draft.

Marcus: keep price bands same. i'll tag demo leads with `pricing_mar_experiment`. also will notify AEs about name swap.

Alejandro: tier names control: "Starter | Developer | Production". variant: "Launch | Scale | Enterprise". keep descriptors.

Emily: legal note: no absolutes. add caveat to calc: "Estimates only; excludes infra and third-party fees." tag me on copy.

Olivia: Figma frames uploaded: https://figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/pricing-microtest-new 1 desktop + mobile.

Samir: instrumentation: events pricing_page_view, pricing_cta_click, pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_calc_feedback. flags: tierNamesVariant, calcCopyVariant. adding post-calc yes/no survey.

Maya: timeline: design + legal signoff Thu, dev flags + QA Fri, rollout Mon (50% traffic) for 14 days.

Alejandro: i'll build a dashboard (trial CTR, contact CTR, demo MQL, calc->self-serve rate). need Amplitude events with flag metadata.

Kate: dropping CTA nudge drafts and a short webinar follow-up blurb by EOD.

Emily: reviewed FAQ PR 1 replaced "you'll save" with "estimated savings". small edit, tagged.

Olivia: updated figma with Emily's copy + small-screen accordion states.

Samir: QA checklist posted:
- flags toggle
- events include flag metadata
- calc math unchanged
- survey modal fires
- accessibility checks

Maya: action items: Kate (CTA + webinar blurb) EOD; Emily (legal signoff) Thu; Olivia (final Figma) Thu; Samir (flags+events) Fri; Marcus (AE note + lead tag) Fri; Alejandro (dashboard) Mon AM. i'll run 15m dry run Fri.

Marcus: will add routing tag and AE note Friday.

Alejandro: small ask 1 capture utm on calc submit to see channel differences.

Samir: adding utm capture to pricing_calc_submit.

Maya: perfect. i'll post recap in #marketing before rollout. :rocket:
